scenarios.detail: Attention rendered episode-1 through the real EphiReadDataSource/Base table path; PostgreSQL source row and 1 record were visible.
Episode decision brief opened at /episode after Attention selection; episode-1, analysis-1, workflow version 0 and source READY were visible.
Real UI Claim then Acknowledge committed episode-1 to workflow version 2. PostgreSQL showed 2 command receipts, 2 audit events and 2 outbox events.
Application process restarted while the browser page remained open; reload/reconnect rendered episode-1 ACKNOWLEDGED from PostgreSQL at workflow version 2.
scenarios.expected_transport_rejection: Planned restart produced bounded connection-refused WebSocket attempts before reload; no unexpected framework/page exception followed.

scenarios.detail: Independent engineer-1 and engineer-2 application processes loaded episode-3 at workflow version 0. Engineer-1 committed Claim version 1; engineer-2 stale Claim rendered Version conflict and Refresh. PostgreSQL retained one winner.

Same subject page was retained across application restart; after capability removal and auth/security revision rotation, the next Acknowledge attempt rendered Permission denied. No receipt disclosure or page continuation bypassed current authorization.
PostgreSQL stopped while Attention remained open. UI retained 56 known records and rendered Stale data, not HEALTHY, empty-success or numeric zero.

After PostgreSQL restart, the required UI Refresh did not recover. The page remained Stale data; server logged psycopg OperationalError: the connection is closed after the earlier AdminShutdown. This is a real candidate runtime defect requiring separate FIX.

Dedicated browser-page retained-snapshot expiry/Refresh qualification was not continued after the real restore/reconnect defect was discovered. Direct R2 PostgreSQL read-snapshot evidence remains prior candidate-bound evidence only.

No unexpected browser console/page errors occurred during ready, workflow, conflict, revocation or mobile runs. Expected WebSocket connection-refused messages were isolated to the planned restart window. The S08 server-side closed-connection stack is recorded as the decisive product defect, not hidden.

Mobile Acknowledge button received keyboard focus at x=41,y=675,w=308,h=44 within the 390x844 viewport; mobile overflow was 0px. Desktop ready/conflict/source states had no horizontal overflow; mobile ready had no horizontal overflow.
